blocks.x: Process industries run on continuous physics: yields, energy and safety windows decided by process telemetry. Advanced process control plus predictive maintenance plus energy intelligence is the classic compounding stack — now with agentic planning on top.

The workflows we industrialize here: APC/advanced control, Predictive maintenance, Batch genealogy/investigation, Energy optimization, Safety instrumented systems. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: APC setpoints static while feedstock shifts; yield and energy losses accepted as normal.
Compressors, columns and boilers hold failure precursors nobody sees.
SIS/DCS estates face convergence threats with physical consequence; IEC 62443 incomplete.
Batch records, quality and ERP data disjoint; investigations slow and audits painful.
Steam/power/cooling costs per unit unknown; optimization targets guessed.
Blend/formulation spaces are combinatorial; incumbent search stops early.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: ML models augmenting control loops with constraint awareness — yield up 2-5 points
vibration/thermal telemetry on compressors and pumps — downtime down 30-50%
62443 zones around safety systems with monitoring — safety integrity protected
batch/quality/ERP unified with lineage — investigations in hours
blend optimization benchmarked across solvers — cost per tonne down
